name: Bohemian Rose

passive_description.localized:
Increases ATK by <lv>{0}</>.
Grants 1 stack of Chaos Thorn each time the wearer deals DoT. Increases CRIT DMG by <lv>{1}</> per stack for <lv>{2}</>s. Triggers at most <lv>once</> every <lv>0.3</>s, up to <lv>10</> stacks and refreshes the duration when retriggered. Grants <lv>10</> stacks of Chaos Thorn immediately when the wearer casts a Redirect Skill.
Extends the Broken state of a Broken enemy by <lv>{3}</>s when the wearer deals damage to them (triggers at most once per Break Effect).
passive_description.source:
攻击力提高<lv>{0}</>。
装备者每次造成持续伤害时获得一层「暗棘」，暴击伤害提高<lv>{1}</>，持续<lv>{2}</>秒，每<lv>0.3</>秒最多触发<lv>1</>次，至多叠加<lv>10</>层，重复触发刷新持续时间；当装备者释放「变轨技能」的时候，会立刻获得<lv>10</>层「暗棘」。
当装备者对处于倾陷状态的敌人造成伤害的时候，会让敌人的倾陷状态延长<lv>{3}</>秒。(单次倾陷效果内最多触发一次。)

tested_hypotheses: The frozen ATK percentage is unconditional and joins the live base-ATK-scaled ATK sum (ATK_static + base_atk * p), never multiplying compiled static ATK (COMBAT_FORMULA_CONTRACT sections 1-2). runtime_execution_validated=true, scoped to the live hit path (hit/calculation.rs -> gear.rs:312 -> rose::damage_bonus -> add_atk_percent), proven by the 1340-vs-1368 falsifier.

A Redirect Skill cast grants 10 Chaos Thorn stacks immediately, bypassing the DoT ICD (separate native sentence, 'immediately'). runtime_execution_validated=true (admission -> gear::on_cast -> gear.rs:277 -> rose::on_cast), proven by the live 2964/2964/2280 test.
Chaos Thorn stacks are a wearer-only timed buff (rose.chaos_thorn, PerSource, 3s from buff_Rose_CD, Reset refresh, 10-stack cap, AllAtOnce decay), proven by the shared-expiry oracle.

Each Thorn stack adds buff_Rose_CritDamageUp to the additive CRIT DMG zone (add_crit_damage), summed with character base and other bonuses per COMBAT_FORMULA_CONTRACT. runtime_execution_validated=true wherever stacks exist (same damage_bonus path; live via the redirect test, direct zone oracle).

The DoT trigger is gated by a 0.3s per-wearer ICD (rose.thorn_icd buff). runtime_execution_validated=staged/hypothesis: gear::on_hit is routed, but the engine generates no wearer-owned DoT packets (native lacrimosa blood DoT scheduling pending), so no live trigger exists; grant_thorn_stacks is a tested buff-manipulation function exercised via invoke_gear_hook.
The Broken-state extension (buff_Rose_UnbalTime, 3s, once per Break Effect) is unmodeled: the runtime has no break-gauge timing to extend.
The frozen ExclusiveCharacterIDArray ['1004'] is cosmetic (skin change only) and does not restrict equipment; group legality is enforced via ApplyGroupType TWO.
Frozen package evidence does not establish Global release availability.
